Overview.Name: Harshitha
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & lightly cooked vegetables
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Curd rice (~150 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Paneer cubes (120 g) + lightly cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid very spicy, fried and heavy foods as they may worsen IBS symptoms.
Eat meals slowly and maintain regular meal timing to reduce stress eating.
Late-night eating can worsen digestion and cravings, so keep dinner lighter.
Get morning sunlight exposure regularly as it can improve digestion, sleep quality, stress control and energy levels.
Simple home-cooked meals and consistent yoga will improve digestion and energy.
